```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const example = new tencentcloud.ga2.GlobalAccelerator("example", {
    name: "tf-example",
    instanceChargeType: "POSTPAID",
    description: "tf example global accelerator",
    tags: {
        createdBy: "Terraform",
    },
});
const exampleAccelerateArea = new tencentcloud.ga2.AccelerateArea("example", {
    globalAcceleratorId: example.id,
    accelerateRegion: "ap-guangzhou",
    bandwidth: 10,
    ispType: "BGP",
    ipVersion: "IPv4",
});
const exampleListener = new tencentcloud.ga2.Listener("example", {
    globalAcceleratorId: exampleAccelerateArea.globalAcceleratorId,
    name: "tf-example-tcp",
    protocol: "TCP",
    portRanges: {
        fromPort: 80,
        toPort: 80,
    },
    description: "tf example listener",
    getRealIpType: "ProxyProtocol",
    clientAffinity: "Open",
    listenerType: "Standard",
    idleTimeout: 900,
});
const exampleEndpointGroup = new tencentcloud.ga2.EndpointGroup("example", {
    globalAcceleratorId: example.id,
    listenerId: exampleListener.listenerId,
    endpointGroupType: "DEFAULT",
    endpointGroupConfiguration: {
        name: "tf-example",
        endpointGroupRegion: "ap-guangzhou",
        description: "tf example endpoint group",
        enableHealthCheck: true,
        checkType: "TCP",
        connectTimeout: 2,
        healthCheckInterval: 30,
        healthyThreshold: 3,
        unhealthyThreshold: 3,
        endpointConfigurations: [
            {
                endpointType: "CustomPublicIp",
                endpointService: "1.1.1.1",
                weight: 50,
            },
            {
                endpointType: "CustomDomain",
                endpointService: "example.com",
                weight: 90,
            },
        ],
        portOverrides: [{
            listenerPort: 80,
            endpointPort: 90,
        }],
    },
});
```

package main

import (
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3/go/pulumi"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/ga2"
)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		example, err := ga2.NewGlobalAccelerator(ctx, "example", &ga2.GlobalAcceleratorArgs{
			Name:               pulumi.String("tf-example"),
			InstanceChargeType: pulumi.String("POSTPAID"),
			Description:        pulumi.String("tf example global accelerator"),
			Tags: pulumi.StringMap{
				"createdBy": pulumi.String("Terraform"),
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		exampleAccelerateArea, err := ga2.NewAccelerateArea(ctx, "example", &ga2.AccelerateAreaArgs{
			GlobalAcceleratorId: example.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			AccelerateRegion:    pulumi.String("ap-guangzhou"),
			Bandwidth:           pulumi.Int(10),
			IspType:             pulumi.String("BGP"),
			IpVersion:           pulumi.String("IPv4"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		exampleListener, err := ga2.NewListener(ctx, "example", &ga2.ListenerArgs{
			GlobalAcceleratorId: exampleAccelerateArea.GlobalAcceleratorId,
			Name:                pulumi.String("tf-example-tcp"),
			Protocol:            pulumi.String("TCP"),
			PortRanges: &ga2.ListenerPortRangesArgs{
				FromPort: pulumi.Int(80),
				ToPort:   pulumi.Int(80),
			},
			Description:    pulumi.String("tf example listener"),
			GetRealIpType:  pulumi.String("ProxyProtocol"),
			ClientAffinity: pulumi.String("Open"),
			ListenerType:   pulumi.String("Standard"),
			IdleTimeout:    pulumi.Int(900),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = ga2.NewEndpointGroup(ctx, "example", &ga2.EndpointGroupArgs{
			GlobalAcceleratorId: example.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			ListenerId:          exampleListener.ListenerId,
			EndpointGroupType:   pulumi.String("DEFAULT"),
			EndpointGroupConfiguration: &ga2.EndpointGroupEndpointGroupConfigurationArgs{
				Name:                pulumi.String("tf-example"),
				EndpointGroupRegion: pulumi.String("ap-guangzhou"),
				Description:         pulumi.String("tf example endpoint group"),
				EnableHealthCheck:   pulumi.Bool(true),
				CheckType:           pulumi.String("TCP"),
				ConnectTimeout:      pulumi.Int(2),
				HealthCheckInterval: pulumi.Int(30),
				HealthyThreshold:    pulumi.Int(3),
				UnhealthyThreshold:  pulumi.Int(3),
				EndpointConfigurations: ga2.EndpointGroupEndpointGroupConfigurationEndpointConfigurationArray{
					&ga2.EndpointGroupEndpointGroupConfigurationEndpointConfigurationArgs{
						EndpointType:    pulumi.String("CustomPublicIp"),
						EndpointService: pulumi.String("1.1.1.1"),
						Weight:          pulumi.Int(50),
					},
					&ga2.EndpointGroupEndpointGroupConfigurationEndpointConfigurationArgs{
						EndpointType:    pulumi.String("CustomDomain"),
						EndpointService: pulumi.String("example.com"),
						Weight:          pulumi.Int(90),
					},
				},
				PortOverrides: ga2.EndpointGroupEndpointGroupConfigurationPortOverrideArray{
					&ga2.EndpointGroupEndpointGroupConfigurationPortOverrideArgs{
						ListenerPort: pulumi.Int(80),
						EndpointPort: pulumi.Int(90),
					},
				},
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}

    health_check_interval = 30

}

    </dt>
    <dd>Health check request method. Valid values: <code>GET</code>, <code>HEAD</code>. Required when <code>checkType</code> is <code>HTTP</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"

    </dt>
    <dd>Health check URL path. Must match the regular expression <code>^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-/]{1,80}$</code>. Required when <code>checkType</code> is <code>HTTP</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="checkport_yaml">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Health check port. Valid range: [1, 65535]. Required when <code>checkType</code> is <code>CUSTOM</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="checkrecvcontext_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#checkrecvcontext_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">check<wbr>Recv<wbr>Context</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Expected health check response content. Length must be between 1 and 500 bytes. Required when <code>checkType</code> is <code>CUSTOM</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="checksendcontext_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#checksendcontext_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">check<wbr>Send<wbr>Context</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Health check request payload. Length must be between 1 and 500 bytes. Required when <code>checkType</code> is <code>CUSTOM</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="checktype_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#checktype_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">check<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Health check protocol. Valid values: <code>TCP</code> (only when the endpoint group's listener protocol is TCP), <code>HTTP</code> (only when the listener protocol is HTTP/HTTPS), <code>PING</code> (only when the listener protocol is UDP), <code>CUSTOM</code> (only when the listener protocol is TCP/UDP). Required when <code>enableHealthCheck</code> is <code>true</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="cipherpolicyid_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#cipherpolicyid_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cipher<wbr>Policy<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>HTTPS cipher suite policy. Valid values: <code>tls_policy_1.0-2</code>, <code>tls_policy_1.1-2</code>, <code>tls_policy_1.2</code>, <code>tls_policy_1.2_strict</code>, <code>tls_policy_1.2_strict-1.3</code>. Required when <code>forwardProtocol</code> is <code>HTTPS</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Number</span>
    </dt>

Required when the listener protocol is HTTP or HTTPS.</dd><dt class="property-optional"

        <span class="property-type">Number</span>

            title="Optional">

## Import



GA2 endpoint group can be imported using the composite ID `<global_accelerator_id>#<listener_id>#<endpoint_group_id>`, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Ga2/endpointGroup:EndpointGroup example ga-4mredmiu#lsr-1vd1fdwf#epg-h0ebutmo
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
